native_mechanisms: Nightingales always descend first onto the unlocked stone bearing the smallest owed letter (extract-min on tentative distance).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by its thief's toll, one direction at a time (directed, per-edge-weight relaxation from the current stone).
A locked letter is never rebuilt again, and threads reaching nowhere are dropped so those stones keep their unreadable debt (settled nodes are final; unreachable nodes stay at infinity).
core_technique: Exact Dijkstra via a monotone circular bucket (Dial/radix-style) queue with a bitmask of non-empty buckets, doubly-linked-list decrease-key, a zero-weight-edge settle stack, and an AVX2 O(n^2) linear-scan Dijkstra path for small/dense graphs.
